get.description: Get information about Askara integration capabilities

post.description:
Extract text from image using OCR

This endpoint is designed for Askara to extract text from scanned documents
and images, making them searchable within the knowledge base.

Example:
    POST /askara/ocr
    {
        "image_url": "http://192.168.0.250:8080/documents/scan.jpg",
        "language": "en",
        "enhance": true
    }

Generate natural language caption for image

This endpoint generates descriptions of images found in documents,
enabling Askara to answer questions about visual content.

Example:
    POST /askara/caption
    {
        "image_url": "http://192.168.0.250:8080/documents/diagram.png",
        "detail_level": "detailed"
    }

Answer questions about image content

This endpoint enables Askara users to ask questions about specific
images in their documents and receive direct answers.

Example:
    POST /askara/visual-qa
    {
        "image_url": "http://192.168.0.250:8080/documents/product.jpg",
        "question": "What color is the product?",
        "context": "Product manual, page 5"
    }

Enhance document image quality

This endpoint improves the quality of scanned documents before OCR,
resulting in better text extraction accuracy.

Supported operations:
- deskew: Correct image rotation
- denoise: Remove noise/artifacts
- contrast: Improve contrast
- sharpen: Increase sharpness

Example:
    POST /askara/enhance
    {
        "image_url": "http://192.168.0.250:8080/documents/scan-poor.jpg",
        "operations": ["deskew", "denoise", "contrast"]
    }

Classify document type from image

This endpoint analyzes the first page or cover of a document to
automatically categorize it (invoice, contract, manual, etc.).

Example:
    POST /askara/classify-document
    {
        "image_url": "http://192.168.0.250:8080/documents/firstpage.jpg",
        "possible_types": ["invoice", "receipt", "contract", "manual"]
    }

Parse document and extract structured content using Docling

Supports: PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, images, and more
Returns: Text, markdown, structure (headings/paragraphs), tables, metadata

Example:
    POST /askara/parse
    {
        "document_url": "http://192.168.0.250:8080/documents/report.pdf",
        "preserve_structure": true,
        "extract_tables": true,
        "extract_images": true
    }

Rerank documents using cross-encoder model for semantic relevance

This endpoint provides semantic reranking of retrieved documents using
BGE cross-encoder models, improving retrieval quality after initial
hybrid search (vector + FTS).

Use this after hybrid search to rerank top candidates and return
the most semantically relevant results.

Example:
    POST /askara/rerank
    {
        "query": "What is machine learning?",
        "documents": [
            {"id": "0", "text": "Machine learning is a subset of AI..."},
            {"id": "1", "text": "Paris is the capital of France..."},
            {"id": "2", "text": "Deep learning uses neural networks..."}
        ],
        "top_k": 2,
        "model": "BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3"
    }

Returns:
    Results sorted by relevance score (highest first), limited to top_k
